sources.title: AI Agent Security Cheat Sheet / Agentic AI guidance
sources.finding_used: High-impact effects should preserve an independent execution gate, exact action/target/parameter binding, short-lived approval artifacts, auditability and replay protection; read-only/low-risk autonomy can be treated differently from irreversible/high-impact operations.
sources.project_effect: Supports exact ConfirmationReceipt binding and effect-class separation; does not override owner-fixed policy.

sources.title: Atomic Commit / Transactions / Isolation / PRAGMA synchronous documentation
sources.finding_used: SQLite transactions provide local ACID/atomic commit semantics including crash recovery; writes are serialized; durability depends on journal/synchronous configuration.
sources.project_effect: Supports H1 local durable reservation implementation and motivates explicit FULL durability configuration plus crash tests.

sources.title: Making retries safe with idempotent APIs
sources.finding_used: A timeout can leave the client unable to know whether an external side effect occurred. Safe retries require service-level idempotency semantics/client tokens or reconciliation rather than assuming the failed response means no effect.
sources.project_effect: Directly motivated OUTCOME_UNKNOWN and the distinction SAFE_TO_RETRY_SAME_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY vs RECONCILE_REQUIRED.

sources.title: Idempotency-Key HTTP Header Field draft
sources.status_as_of_retrieval: expired draft; not treated as a current RFC
sources.finding_used: Historical design precedent for client-unique idempotency keys and request fingerprints.
sources.project_effect: Terminology/design precedent only; no standards claim promoted.

counterhypothesis: Local transaction durability plus one-shot confirmation may still duplicate or lose knowledge of an external effect if the process fails after an external provider acts but before the local verified outcome is committed.
discriminator: Model attempt-start and unknown-outcome states explicitly; permit automatic retry only with a verified downstream idempotency contract and the same key; otherwise require reconciliation.
promotion_boundary: External sources support engineering patterns; H1 tests remain local implementation evidence and no universal exactly-once or prompt-injection-impossibility claim is made.
